verdict.rationale: Persona's API clearly supports agent-style automation: pre-creating inquiries (docs-18), polling status/fetching verification details (docs-27), webhooks for outcome updates (docs-21,34), and workflows that can trigger additional reports (docs-23,41). However there is no MCP server/surface mentioned anywhere in the evidence, no explicit 'trigger re-check' endpoint beyond workflow-triggered re-reports, and credential scoping is only weakly evidenced via IP allowlisting (docs-36) rather than fine-grained scoped API keys. Missing for 10: MCP surface, explicit re-check/retry API, granular scoped-credential mechanism (e.g., per-session tokens), independent confirmation of agent-driven orchestration.
